title: A determination of whether the dimensionless constants of physics are calculable

concept.text: Strings 2000 problem 1 (proposed by David Gross): are all the measurable dimensionless parameters that characterize the physical universe calculable in principle, or are some merely determined by historical or quantum mechanical accident and uncalculable? Sources given: https://preskill.caltech.edu/millennium.html ; https://aip.brightspotcdn.com/PTO.v54.i10.14_2.online.pdf ; https://x.com/martinmbauer/status/1779906631003697211.

change_log.change: Added by hand to PHY on 2026-11-15.
change_log.reason: One of the ten Physics Problems for the Next Millennium chosen at the Strings 2000 conference (University of Michigan) by a panel of Michael Duff, David Gross and Edward Witten; added at the owner's request, November 14, 2026.
